title: Creation, format version 1
description: A post: text, an image or a video, usually a take on one or more stories. Our own (made by News Desk), invited creators' and users' posts (posted in the app) all have this shape, so the feed treats them alike.

format.description: Says this record is a creation, in format version 1.

route.description: How it reached the product, which follows from its author: made for our own content, posted for creators' and users' posts. Product credits it by its route.

kind.description: text: words only. image: one image, with words if wanted. video: one video, with words if wanted.

author.description: Who made it. Set by our own software from the account that posted it, never taken from the post itself.

kind.description: hrizzup: our own content, made by News Desk and posted from a Hrizzup account. creator: an invited creator, from their creator account. user: anyone else with an account, who posts text only.

account_id.description: The account it was posted from.

text.description: The words. Required for text; for an image or a video, an optional caption.

image.description: The image. Required for an image, and only there.

video.description: The video. Required for a video, and only there.

story_ids.description: The stories it is a take on. It shows on those stories, and wherever they show.

categories.description: What it is about: needed when it isn't a take on a story, and adds to its stories' categories when it is.

locations.description: Where it matters, for local content.

based_on.description: The sourced items (posts our bots found) it builds on. Product credits their creators alongside it, linking to the original posts while they're live. Only for made content.
